definitions.explanation: Watching a situation unfold without getting involved or taking action. Often carries a negative connotation of passivity or indifference when action might be needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧{傍観|ぼうかん}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I just stood by and watched.

examples.japanese: ⟦いじめ→いじめ：09092_ijime⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傍観|ぼうかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
examples.english: You shouldn't just stand by and watch bullying happen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ}→傍観者：20381_boukansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いられない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I can't remain just a bystander.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傍観|ぼうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{助|たす}けようとしなかった→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone just looked on at the accident, and nobody tried to help.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傍観|ぼうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧か⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I know it's wrong to just stand by when someone is in trouble, but I didn't know what I could do.

notes:
{傍観|ぼうかん}する is to watch a situation from the side without stepping in. What is watched takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦いじめ→いじめ：09092_ijime⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傍観|ぼうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (stand by and watch bullying). The word is almost never used of a situation that calls for no action — the implied criticism is built in.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
・{傍|ぼう} - beside, nearby
・{観|かん} - to watch, to observe

KEY DERIVATIVES:
・⟦{傍観者|ぼうかんしゃ}→傍観者：20381_boukansha⟧ - bystander, onlooker, spectator
・{傍観|ぼうかん}⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ - stance of non-involvement

NUANCE:
{傍観|ぼうかん} often implies criticism - that someone should be acting but is choosing not to. It suggests moral passivity or indifference.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{傍観|ぼうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}め{込|こ}む→決め込む：13343_kimekomu⟧ - to decide to stay out of it
・{傍観|ぼうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ - attitude of non-involvement
・{傍観|ぼうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{徹|てっ}する→徹する：12567_tessuru⟧ - to remain strictly as an observer

CONTRASTING TERMS:
・⟦{介入|かいにゅう}→介入：07425_kainyuu⟧ - intervention (opposite action)
・⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧ - participation
・⟦{関与|かんよ}→関与：08646_kanyo⟧ - involvement

REGISTER:
Neutral to formal. Common in news and discussions of social issues.
